title: Domain gate fails OPEN on an empty host: _host_matches('','') is True, so a SecretRef with an empty-string domain releases the real secret for an unparseable destination
evidence: src/autotester/browser/secrets.py:61-63 _host_matches; :105-118 resolve never rejects host=='' from host_of(). Probe: SecretStore(proj(domains=['']),{'PW':'supersecretvalue'}).resolve('{{SECRET:PW}}','') returned 'supersecretvalue' with no exception. host_of() returns '' for any unparseable url_or_host, and SecretRef.domains (schema/project.py:22) has no validator rejecting '' entries. CYCLE-2 RE-CHECK: secrets.py:128-130 raises SecretScopeError on empty host; schema/project.py:32-39 rejects blank domains. Reproduced closed for '', '   ', '://broken', '?x=1', '#frag', '//', 'http://', '\x00', and for a SecretRef.model_construct() bypass of the validator (resolve still fails closed).

title: guard_prompt does NOT raise on a raw secret value shorter than 4 characters, and Redactor does not mask it — B2's 'raises rather than being masked-and-sent' is conditional in practice
evidence: src/autotester/core/redact.py:15 _MIN_SECRET_LEN=4, applied in assert_no_raw_secrets():69 and Redactor.__init__():28. Probe: store with {'PW':'abc'}; store.guard_prompt('password is abc') returned normally (no ValueError); store.redactor().scrub('password=abc') returned 'password=abc' unmasked. CYCLE-2 RE-CHECK: _MIN_SECRET_LEN removed (redact.py:28-31, :70-72). Reproduced closed for 3-char and 1-char declared values in both guard_prompt and Redactor.scrub; tests/test_core.py old short-value test replaced (encoded the bug).

title: parse_env does not strip trailing inline comments, so 'PW=abc # note' loads the wrong value AND makes the Redactor mask the wrong string
evidence: src/autotester/browser/secrets.py:36-52. Probe: parse_env('PW=abc # note\n') == {'PW': 'abc # note'}. CYCLE-2 RE-CHECK: _clean_value (secrets.py:52-57) strips ' #...' from unquoted values; quoted values and URL fragments preserved. Reproduced closed for the filed case. Residual variants (tab before '#', quoted value followed by a comment) filed separately as AT-006.

title: Undeclared .env values are absent from the Redactor, so a stray credential in the same file appears verbatim in logs and artifacts
evidence: src/autotester/browser/secrets.py:100-101 (only declared keys enter self._values) and :134-136 redactor() built from self._values. Probe: .env with STRAY=strayvalue123 -> store.redactor().scrub('log strayvalue123') left it unmasked. CYCLE-2 RE-CHECK: _shadow map (secrets.py:87-91, :150-160) feeds redactor() and guard_prompt(); resolve() of an undeclared key still raises UndeclaredSecret; __repr__/keys()/__contains__ exclude shadow. Reproduced closed, including a two-project shared .env (each project masks the other's value, neither can resolve it). Contract B1 amended to 'ignored for use, still masked' (see browser-and-secrets.md amendment log).

title: SecretStore.load(strict=False) is a security-relevant branch with no test coverage
evidence: src/autotester/browser/secrets.py:82,95. tests/test_secrets.py has 16 tests, none exercising strict=False. CYCLE-2 RE-CHECK: tests/test_secrets.py:188-194 test_at005_non_strict_load_still_fails_closed_at_resolve pins it. Reproduced closed for an empty-value key and for an absent file under strict=False (MissingSecret at resolve).

title: parse_env inline-comment stripping only recognises ' #' (space-hash): a tab before '#' and a quoted value followed by a comment both load a wrong value, so the Redactor masks the wrong string
evidence: src/autotester/browser/secrets.py:52-57 _clean_value: quote-unwrapping runs first and only when the WHOLE value is quoted; comment stripping partitions on ' #' only. Probe: parse_env('PW=abc\t# note\n') == {'PW': 'abc\t# note'}; parse_env('PW="abc" # c\n') == {'PW': '"abc"'} (quotes retained). Same consequence class as AT-003: the credential typed/masked is not the real one. Fix direction: split on whitespace+'#' (regex \s#), and strip the comment BEFORE unquoting when the value starts with a quote and the closing quote precedes the '#'.

title: host_of() disagrees with the browser on backslash-userinfo URLs: resolve() releases the secret for 'https://evil.test\@pathlynks.test', which Chromium (WHATWG) navigates to evil.test
evidence: src/autotester/browser/secrets.py:60-63 host_of uses urllib.parse.urlparse, which treats 'evil.test\\' as userinfo and returns hostname 'pathlynks.test'. WHATWG URL (what Chromium/Playwright implement; verified with node `new URL(...)`): backslash is a path separator in special schemes, so host='evil.test', path='/@pathlynks.test'. Probe: SecretStore(proj(domains=['pathlynks.test']),{'PW':'supersecretvalue'}).resolve('{{SECRET:PW}}','https://evil.test\\@pathlynks.test') RETURNED the value. B3 says scoping is enforced against the current page host; here the page host would be evil.test. Note: 'https://evil.test%2F@pathlynks.test' is consistent on both parsers (host pathlynks.test) and is NOT a leak; the cycle-1 userinfo probe ('a.test@evil.test') was the safe direction. Fix direction (fail closed, two lines): in host_of() return '' when the raw input contains a backslash or when urlparse yields a username/password (any userinfo) — an empty host already raises SecretScopeError since AT-001. Add both as tests. T-010 must additionally pass the browser's own page.url (post-navigation) to resolve(), never the step's intended URL.

title: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and the SecretRef docstring still say the credential file is projects/<slug>/.env, and the concept->file table has no row for the credential boundary (browser/secrets.py)
evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:74 'Values live only in projects/<slug>/.env'; :85 layout block lists '.env (ignored)' under projects/<slug>/; :30-41 table has no entry for SecretStore / browser/secrets.py; :116 Status still says 'Next: browser/'. src/autotester/schema/project.py:14 docstring 'The value lives only in projects/<slug>/.env'. Reality since the user's 2026-09-03 instruction: core/paths.py:39-45 env_file = <repo root>/.env, and .env.example documents that. C2 requires the concept->file table to match reality; the unit added a concept (the credential boundary) without adding its row, and the mid-cycle path change left two stale statements. Fix: one table row + two line edits + the docstring; ARCHITECTURE.md stays under 150 lines.
